step1.title: Create the room
step1.desc: Choose the game language (English or Spanish) and get a 6-character code instantly.

step2.title: Gather the team
step2.desc: Share the code and up to 20 people join with their name from mobile or browser. No install needed.

step3.title: Play and vote
step3.desc: Each round a question card comes out, everyone plays their answer and the judge crowns the funniest.

step1.title: Create the room
step1.desc: Choose "Truth or Lie", the language, and the points to win. Get a 6-character code.

step2.title: Write your statements
step2.desc: When it's your turn in the spotlight, write two truths and a lie about yourself — or draw from the deck.
step2.statement1: I've lived in three different countries
step2.statement2: I have a scuba diving certification

step3.title: Everyone votes
step3.desc: Everyone else guesses which one is false. Score a point for every person you fool, and a point for every lie you catch.

vomPromo.desc: Two truths and a lie about each person on the team. Everyone votes, no one judges. The one who fools scores, and so does the one who catches the lie.
vomPromo.statement1: I've lived in three different countries
vomPromo.question: Which one is the lie?
